passages.provision_quote: (b) “Race” is inclusive of traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles.
passages.note: Bill text page for the same near-unanimous vote; it prints the provision but names no voter and no tally.

rows.reasoning: The only record is her Aye on SB 188 (2019-2020), which passed the Senate "Ayes Count 37 Noes Count 0 NVR Count 1" — a near-unanimous vote that under V4 cannot carry a chair alone, so no passage survives V1–V5. On its content the bill adds hair texture and protective hairstyles to the definition of race; it neither "mandate[s] racial equity requirements in all institutions" nor matches the enforcement clause of "strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination", so even a contested version of this vote would not seat a rung by itself.
